description.text: IntroductionThis program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.Main CoursesInternational Trade Practice, International Trade, International Finance, International Investment, International Marketing, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, etc.Degree AwardedQualified student will be granted Bachelor of International Economy and Trade by North China University of TechnologyInternshipThey will be able to handle international business and economic cooperation.Future Career They will be qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at North China University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4111 USD/per year ￥ 29600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport ;2.Application form ;3.High school transcripts ;4.High school graduation certificate;5.Self-introduction video ( 3-5 minutes ):Self-introduction (age, family background, education background, personality, hobbies)Why do you choose to study this major ?Why do you choose to study in Nanchang Hangkong University ?How do you spend your four years in China ?Documents needed for applying for JW202 form:6.two inch photo (photo of passport);7.physical examination form;8.non-criminal record;9.Proof of bank deposit.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
